summary: Iteration 11 QA of Haul Yeah CRM new features: sales commissions (math + lifecycle + role gates + rep scoping + editable rate table), owner availability overview (weekend flags + shortage detection), profile task (open/done/auto-complete on profile save), and owner login rename (HaulYeahAdmin, old HaulYeahOwner fails). Backend: 28/28 pytest cases pass in ~8s. Frontend: 36/39 UI checks pass across owner + sales ghost + crew ghost + marketing ghost. Two 'failures' are actually by-design (see below). Everything critical works. Final state: clean — all TEST_ commission attributions had closed_by cleared, rates restored to defaults (big_pct 12), temp user deleted, junior availability restored, QA assignment deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py commission_amount (~L4216): tier logic uses >= for big_min and >= for medium_min in a fall-through order. A $1500 quote → medium tier (10%) = $150, a $1499 quote → small-flat by move_type. Correct math verified via 4 concrete test cases + big_pct edit case.

server.py save_attribution (~L4285): payment_fields = ('deposit_paid','deposit_paid_at','fully_paid','fully_paid_at','refunded'); non-owner touching any of these → 403 'Only the owner can change payment flags.' Verified with sales ghost.

server.py commissions_report (~L4362): status filters (None, 'none') are excluded so leads without closed_by never appear in rows/reps. Cleanup by setting closed_by='' works. Voided leads keep appearing but add to `voided` bucket only (not pending/locked) — correct.

server.py availability_overview (~L4442): needed_by_date uses max(len(a.crew), 2) — floors 'needed' at 2 per job even for single-crew assignments. `short` = needed>0 AND len(available)<needed. Correct.

server.py save_my_member_profile (~L3577): profile_task auto-set to 'done' only when at least one profile field has content (any(prof.values())). Verified — a profile-save with only `nickname:'QA'` flips profile_task.
server.py create_user (~L2431): new users are created with profile_task='open' + notify() sends 'First task: set up your profile' — verified end-to-end via temp user login.

App.js RoleRoutes: /script route is registered for role='sales' only (line 48). Owner navigating directly to /script → Navigate('*') → /. This is by design since the ScriptPanel already lives side-by-side inside /calculator (also sales-only). Owner CAN see /calculator+ScriptPanel via role-switch to sales. Layout.jsx nav gates /calculator and /script to roles:['sales'] and /commissions to roles:['owner','sales'] — consistent.

App.js RoleRoutes: crew and marketing routes deliberately omit /commissions — direct URL /commissions redirects to /today or /marketing via the Navigate('*') fallback (verified). Backend /api/commissions/* additionally 403s crew+marketing tokens — defense-in-depth.

Commissions.jsx: rate table editor only rendered when reps.is_owner is true — so sales sees /commissions WITHOUT the editor (verified). rep-total-card list is empty for sales ghost since no commissions are attributed to them (correct).

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional — 36/39 UI selector checks pass; the 3 non-passes are all by-design (owner /script route not registered by design → Navigate to /; owner /tasks handled by profile-task auto-complete; /todo isn't a registered crew route, /tasks is)

rca of the issue: No unresolved issues. Two edge behaviors worth noting to main agent: (1) owner navigating directly to /script → redirect to / because App.js RoleRoutes registers /script only under role==='sales' — currently intentional since owner is expected to use the ScriptPanel embedded in /calculator via role-switch; if the review-request expectation is that owner CAN also visit standalone /script, add `<Route path="/script" element={<Script />} />` inside the owner fallback branch (~L118 of App.js). (2) crew's To-Do URL is /tasks — the review said 'To-Do page shows the orange card' — verified this renders correctly on /tasks (data-testid=profile-task-card).
